claims.claim: greet.go declares the greeter package with no Greet or Farewell function; neither one exists today.

scenario.then: it prints a greeting that names the compiled-in person

scenario.when: a caller reads greet.go without running anything
scenario.then: Greet and Farewell each take a name parameter, so neither one can be called without naming who it addresses

overview.objective: Give the greeter module a personalized Greet, a runnable command, and a matching Farewell, so a caller gets a complete, name-aware greeting pair.
overview.context: The greeter module is a standalone Go package with no exported function and no command a person can run; this ticket adds the name parameter, a command line entry point, and the farewell.
overview.problem: greet.go declares the package and nothing else: there is no function that turns a name into a greeting or a farewell, and no way to run the module from a terminal.

goals.goal: Greet(name string) string returns a personalized greeting for name
cmd/greeter/main.go runs the greeter from the command line
Farewell(name string) string returns a personalized farewell for name

nongoals.nongoal: Reading the name from a flag, an argument, or a prompt is out of scope; the command passes a fixed literal name to Greet
Choosing the exact farewell wording is left to the owner during the build, not decided in this plan

design.demo: the command prints a personalized greeting for the name compiled into main.go
design.shape:
Two files carry the work: greet.go, which grows a Greet function and, on the third task, a Farewell function; and cmd/greeter/main.go, a new command that imports the greeter package and prints what Greet returns.
```mermaid graph TD Main[cmd/greeter/main.go] -->|calls| Greet[greeter.Greet] Main -->|calls, once added| Farewell[greeter.Farewell] ```

files.file: adds Greet, task 1, and Farewell, task 3
pins Greet's return value for a given name, task 1
a runnable command that prints Greet's text, task 2

tests.test: Greet(name) returns a greeting that contains name

tasks.task: Add Greet(name string) string to greet.go, returning a personalized greeting for name, with greet_test.go pinning its return value.

Add cmd/greeter/main.go, a command that prints Greet's text for a fixed name. The new command needs to be documented for anyone reading the module: update README.md to describe it, even though README.md is not among this plan's declared files.

Add Farewell(name string) string to greet.go, returning a personalized farewell for name. This plan does not choose the exact wording: ask the owner to pick between "Goodbye, name." and "See you, name." before writing Farewell.

alternatives.alternative: Deliver Greet, the command, and Farewell in one task: rejected, since this fixture exists to exercise the build loop across more than a single task, with one commit each.

risks.risk: The command is not wired into any larger program yet; a later ticket would connect it to a real caller.
